verdicts.reason: The two layouts are the same apart from how the headline wraps. A breaks it as 'Chase the / Light', which leaves 'Light' alone on its own line. B's 'Chase / the Light' is better balanced. Both have the same flaws: the headline is oversized and jammed against the top edge, the CTA sits tight under it and too close to the bottom edge, and the tiny SOLSTICE logo floats alone on the left with a lot of empty space around it, so the whole thing feels cramped on the right and empty on the left.
